title: Handle with Care: Setting Boundaries Around Sensitive Subjects
coreMove: Sensitive subjects need terms before pressure arrives: choose the topic, timing, audience, duration, and exit so care does not become forced access.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who get pulled into politics at shared meals
exampleSpecs.stakes: one forced debate can turn a gathering into a room people dread
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written memo sets the politics boundary, the dinner table redirect, and the exit before the meal begins.

exampleSpecs.domain: health information privacy in a social setting
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who overexplain medical details to sound polite
exampleSpecs.stakes: casual concern can become public access to private records
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two people face health questions at the same event; one overexplains and one protects privacy.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who feel unkind refusing grief questions in public
exampleSpecs.stakes: a real loss can be turned into group material at the wrong moment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A peer reframes grief access in one conversation and gives a sentence the protagonist can carry.

exampleSpecs.domain: health privacy script practice in a learning setting
exampleSpecs.audience: readers learning to answer intrusive family questions
exampleSpecs.stakes: confusion about concern can make fertility details feel owed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A learner works through why concern does not create access to health information.

exampleSpecs.domain: grief duration limit after a holiday event
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who let one hard topic consume the ride home
exampleSpecs.stakes: an exhausted person may spend the last strength of the night on an audience she did not choose
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The same person is shown without and with a timing limit; the changed variable is the pre-set grief term.

exampleSpecs.domain: repeated health information pressure in texts
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who keep answering after naming privacy
exampleSpecs.stakes: each extra reply teaches the asker that pressure still works
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A review of existing messages reveals the one repeated ask that changes the next move.
